        <payload><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="ecc_agent_script_file"><ecc_agent_script_file action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><checksum>hhnCBl8MNl8iOQ4UVFTnFQ==</checksum><description>Retrieves the details of specified user.</description><directory>false</directory><name>ActionLookupUser_AD_v2.ps1</name><parent display_value="ADv2Spoke">8ed69ce81b8d2010dd8e0e16ec4bcb48</parent><script> Import-Module ActiveDirectory -WarningAction SilentlyContinue

if (test-path env:\SNC_userName) {
    $username = $env:SNC_userName;
}

If(-Not $username){
    $result = "User Name field is empty"
    $status = "Error"  
} 
Else{

$username = $username -replace "%27", "'";

    try {
        $userdetails = Get-ADUser -Identity $username -Credential $cred -Server $computer -Properties * | Select-Object Name, CanonicalName, City, Company, Country, Department, Description, DisplayName, DistinguishedName, EmailAddress, Enabled, GivenName, HomeDirectory, Manager, MemberOf, MobilePhone, ObjectGUID, Office, Organization, SamAccountName, State, StreetAddress, Surname, Title, UserPrincipalName ,  @{n='OU';e={(($_.distinguishedName.Split(",",2)[1]))}}
        $result = $userdetails
        $status = "Success"
    }
    catch {
        $result = $_.Exception.Message
        $status = "Error"
    }
}

$response = @{
    status = $status
    body   = $result
} | convertTo-Json

Write-Output $response </script><script_attachment/><source/><sys_class_name>ecc_agent_script_file</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-07-25 13:25:15</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a81a22d7873815107701ed3e0ebb3563</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ActionLookupUser_AD_v2.ps1</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Microsoft Active Directory v2 Spoke" source="sn_ms_ad_v2_spoke">bcfbc4241b4d2010dd8e0e16ec4bcba5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Microsoft Active Directory v2 Spoke">bcfbc4241b4d2010dd8e0e16ec4bcba5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>ecc_agent_script_file_a81a22d7873815107701ed3e0ebb3563</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-07-27 20:53:05</sys_updated_on><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/><use_attachment>false</use_attachment><version/></ecc_agent_script_file></record_update>]]></payload>
